cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: You First
cards.instruction: Coax someone else into breaking a rule before you do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Try a grape before we buy the bunch. Last week's were sour. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Just one. I'll try the next if nobody objects.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine, but you're holding the bunch where the assistant can see you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. I'll hold it out like samples. You take the first one; if that works, I'll serve myself.

mechanism: A confidently leads an appealing rule-breaking venture while accommodating B conditions so B still takes the first prohibited step.
confusable: Distinguish jointly breaking a rule from maintaining B-first sequence, and distinguish rigid orders from authority softened to retain a willing partner.
comparison: Bride roof photo trades train-carrying help for first entry; grape tasting trades public bunch-holding for B first bite.
seedUse: Canonical bride/grape seeds supply explicit rules and B conditions; keep first-breach sequence visible while integrating S02 adaptation.
